title: Campaign Chronicler
tagline: A long game night becomes a private, searchable story while I sleep.
what: A recorder for long game sessions. It keeps my microphone and the other voices separate, captures the game, transcribes everything on my own PC and turns the night into a session I can search and play back later.
built: Kept my microphone and the other voices on separate channels, with playback for either one or both
Split long sessions into 10-minute chunks and captured a game frame every 15 seconds
Ran transcription, alignment, speaker separation and voice matching on my own graphics card
Synced the audio, transcript and finished session to a private dashboard
starring: The people at my game table

making.problem: A campaign can run for hours. I wanted the story, the voices and the useful moments afterwards without spending the next day cutting up one giant recording.
how: The recorder keeps each side of the conversation on its own channel
Every 10 minutes becomes a chunk, with a game frame saved every 15 seconds
My graphics card transcribes the chunks, lines up the words and separates the speakers
The finished audio and transcript become one searchable session on the dashboard

moment.what: One speaker pass cleaned 19 labels down to 9 real voices, then relabeled 42 older transcripts so those sessions became searchable by the right voice too.
